product_one_liner.value: Wellinks provides virtual chronic-care management and remote patient monitoring to help people with COPD and other chronic cardiopulmonary conditions manage their health between in-person visits.

pricing_page.notes: The public homepage does not show a pricing link or public pricing.

named_customers.notes: These are named Wellinks members whose testimonials appear on the company’s member-stories page.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a news/resources and press archive; it does not show at least two engineer-authored build/architecture posts.

public_docs.notes: The public site presents product, patient, news, legal and contact content but no public documentation site, developer portal or help center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists Senior Data and BI Analyst, not an AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM or computer-vision role.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public product, news/blog and legal/privacy material describes predictive analytics and machine learning but does not name an external AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company publicly identifies and describes its HIPAA privacy practices; the reviewed page does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The announcement says the first close secured $10 million and is dated August 4, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open job board lists Senior Data and BI Analyst and no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The Wellinks App: Action Plan feature page is dated May 7, 2026, within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 31, 2026 announcement says Stephanie Solich was appointed VP of Customer Success and Stephanie Willard and Andrew Brimer were promoted to VP roles.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company profile’s Products & Technology section names Salesforce and NetSuite.
